topic: Asking the HOA Office about Pool and Guest Rules

script.title: AT THE HOA OFFICE
script.scene_zh: 社區辦公室 · 詢問規則
script.story_hook: New in the building, one small question turns into many.
script.intro_zh: 剛搬進大樓，一個小問題變成了一大串疑問。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the HOA office visit. Listen for handy rules questions.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到社區管理辦公室。留意實用的規則詢問句。
script.outro: That's one HOA chat done. Listen again and ask along.
script.outro_zh: 第一次跟管理處聊天就這樣完成。再聽一次，跟著一起問。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his late forties with short salt-and-pepper hair, a trimmed mustache, wire-frame glasses, a navy zip-up fleece over a light blue button shirt, khaki pants, and a broad sturdy build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful older woman in her sixties with short silver hair in soft waves, small gold earrings, glasses on a beaded chain, a plum blouse under a grey cardigan, and a relaxed average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I just moved in here, unit seven B.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ dʒʌst ˈmuːvd ɪn hɪr ˈjunɪt ˈsɛvən bi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我剛搬進來，七B單元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to the building, how can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ haʊ kən aɪ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎搬來這裡，需要我幫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly the pool, honestly, I'm a little lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ðə puːl ˈɑnəstli aɪm ə ˈlɪɾəl lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 老實說主要是泳池，我有點摸不著頭緒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, do you have your resident card yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ du ju hæv jɔɹ ˈɛzɪdənt kɑɹd ˈjɛt/
dialogue.zh: 好，你有住戶識別證了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, someone mentioned a wristband?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈjɛt ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈmɛnʃənd ə ˈrɪstˌbænd/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，有人提到要戴手環？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the front desk gives free bands daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə frʌnt dɛsk ɡɪvz fri bændz ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 對，櫃台每天都發免費手環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can guests use the pool too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt kən ɡɛsts juz ðə puːl tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。賓客也可以用泳池嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They can, with two guest passes each visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kən wɪð tu ɡɛst pæsɪz itʃ ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，每次來要用兩張賓客證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, where do I actually get those passes?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wɛɹ du aɪ ˈæktʃuəli ɡɛt ðoʊz pæsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那些賓客證到底要在哪裡拿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, three per month, just sign this sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ θɹi pɚ mʌnθ dʒʌst saɪn ðɪs ʃit/
dialogue.zh: 這裡，一個月三張，簽這張單就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only three? My family visits a lot, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli θɹi maɪ ˈfæməli ˈvɪzɪts ə lɑt ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 只有三張？我家人常常來，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it, but pool capacity stays strict.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt bʌt puːl kəˈpæsəti steɪz strɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，不過泳池人數上限抓得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense, it gets so crowded on weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns ɪt ɡɛts soʊ ˈkɹaʊdɪd ɑn ˈwikˌɛnds/
dialogue.zh: 有道理，週末總是擠得不得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, so kids need an adult with them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ kɪdz nid ən əˈdʌlt wɪð ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，小孩身邊要有大人陪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. What about the quiet hours rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈaʊəz rul/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。安靜時段的規矩是怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten at night to seven, no loud music outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ət naɪt tə ˈsɛvən noʊ laʊd ˈmjuzɪk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 晚上十點到早上七點，外面不能大聲放音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my brother plays guitar pretty loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈbrʌðə pleɪz ɡɪˈtɑɹ ˈpɹɪti ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我弟弟彈吉他滿大聲的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, tell him indoors after ten, that works.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɛl ɪm ɪnˈdɔɹz ˈæftɚ tɛn ðæt wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 哈，跟他說十點後進屋裡彈就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Now, can I build a small fence?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du naʊ kən aɪ bɪld ə smɔːl fɛns/
dialogue.zh: 我會照做。還有，我可以搭一道小圍欄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the patio? That needs a permit, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ðə ˈpætiˌoʊ ðæt nidz ə ˈpɝmɪt ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 陽台那邊嗎？那需要申請許可，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A permit? Ugh, is that a long process?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpɝmɪt ʌɡ ɪz ðæt ə lɔŋ ˈpɹɑˌsɛs/
dialogue.zh: 申請？唉，程序會很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, one form and a photo of plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɹiˌli wʌn fɔɹm ænd ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv plænz/
dialogue.zh: 還好，一張表格加一張設計照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's easier than I feared, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈizɪɚ ðæn aɪ fɪrd θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那比我想的簡單，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Height caps at four feet, keep it under.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪt kæps æt fɔɹ fit kip ɪt ˈʌndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 高度上限四英尺，別超過就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four feet, noted. Can I paint it any color?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ fit ˈnoʊɾɪd kən aɪ peɪnt ɪt ˈɛni ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 四英尺，記下了。能漆成任何顏色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Earth tones only, the board is picky there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɚθ toʊnz ˈoʊnli ðə bɔɹd ɪz ˈpɪki ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 只能大地色系，董事會對這很講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine by me, beige works great for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn baɪ mi beɪʒ wɝks ɡɹeɪt fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 我沒意見，米色最適合我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Last thing, did you get the dues notice?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt læst θɪŋ dɪd ju ɡɛt ðə duz ˈnoʊɾɪs/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。最後，你收到管理費通知了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The monthly fee? Yeah, it seemed kind of high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌnθli fi jeɪz ɪt sind kaɪnd əv haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那個每個月的費用？嗯，看起來有點高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers the pool, gates, and landscaping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkʌvərz ðə puːl ɡeɪts ænd ˈlændˌskeɪpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 它涵蓋泳池、門禁和綠化維護。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, okay, that actually sounds reasonable.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈæktʃuəli saʊndz ˈɹizənəbl/
dialogue.zh: 噢，好的，那聽起來其實合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most folks grumble, then they see the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst foʊks ˈɡɹʌmbəl ðɛn ðeɪ si ðə puːl/
dialogue.zh: 大家都會抱怨幾句，然後看到泳池就消氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. When's the payment due each month?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ wɛnz ðə ˈpeɪmənt du itʃ mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，合理。每個月的錢何時到期？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First of the month, autopay is the easiest.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst ʌv ðə mʌnθ ˈɔːtoʊˌpeɪ ɪz ði ˈiːziɪst/
dialogue.zh: 每月一號，自動扣款最省事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I set up autopay right here today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ sɛt ʌp ˈɔːtoʊˌpeɪ raɪt hɪɹ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天可以在這裡設定自動扣款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, I just need your bank details.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli aɪ dʒʌst nid jɔɹ bæŋk dɪˈteɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我只要你的銀行資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I don't have those memorized, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ doʊnt hæv ðoʊz ˈmɛməˌɹaɪzd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我沒把那些數字背起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine, take a form home and mail it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn teɪk ə fɔɹm hoʊm ænd meɪl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，帶張表格回家再寄回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better idea, can you email me the form?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɾɚ aɪˈdiə kən ju ˈiˌmeɪl mi ðə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，你能用電子郵件寄一份表格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's your email now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌts jɔɹ ˈiˌmeɪl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你現在的電子郵件是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's new, I made it after I moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts nju aɪ ˈmeɪd ɪt ˈæftɚ aɪ muːvd/
dialogue.zh: 是新的，我搬來之後才申請的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the account shows your old address.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ði əˈkaʊnt ʃoʊz jɔɹ ˈoʊld əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 不過系統裡還是你舊地址的資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's my place from before I moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts maɪ pleɪs fɹəm bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ muːvd/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那是我搬家前住的舊地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common fix, let me update it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən fɪks lɛt mi ˈʌpˌdeɪt ɪt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事，我現在就幫你更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, I really appreciate it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ aɪ ˈɹɪli əˈpɹiʃiˌeɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你真是救星，真的很謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help, you're all set for the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp jʊɹ ɔːl sɛt fɔɹ ðə puːl/
dialogue.zh: 很高興幫忙，泳池那邊你全都弄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Is the pool open this weekend already?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ɪz ðə puːl ˈoʊpən ðɪs ˈwikˌɛnd ɔːlˈɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這週末泳池已經開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine to eight, lifeguard on from eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn tə eɪt ˈlaɪfˌɡɑɹd ɑn fɹəm ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 九點到八點，十一點起有救生員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, my kids will be so excited.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt maɪ kɪdz wɪl bi soʊ ɪkˈsaɪɾɪd/
dialogue.zh: 棒極了，我的小孩會超興奮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring extra bands, they're paper, they tear.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ˈɛkstrə bændz ðɛɹ ˈpeɪpɚ ðeɪ tɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 多帶幾條手環，紙做的一扯就破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, I'll grab a few just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp aɪl ɡɹæb ə fju dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好建議，我多拿幾條以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the fence form goes in the drop box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə fɛns fɔɹm ɡoʊz ɪn ðə dɹɑp bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 還有，圍欄申請單丟進那個箱子就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one by the mail room, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn baɪ ðə meɪl rum raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是郵件室旁邊那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it, blue box, no need to knock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt blu bɑks noʊ nid tə nɑk/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那個藍箱子，不用敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, you answered everything I worried about.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ju ˈænˌsɛɹd ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ aɪ ˈwɝid əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 完美，我擔心的一切你都答完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, moving stress is real, we get it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈmuːvɪŋ stɹɛs ɪz ɹiːəl wi ɡɛt ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，搬家的壓力是真的，我們都懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, thanks a lot for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl θæŋks ə lɑt fɔɹ jɔɹ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 那，真的非常謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, see you around the pool, neighbor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm si ju əˈɹaʊnd ðə puːl ˈneɪbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，泳池見囉，鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you soon, enjoy the rest of your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju sun ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ɛst ʌv jɔɹ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，祝你今天剩下的時間也愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, enjoy your first week in seven B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔɹ fɝst wik ɪn ˈsɛvən bi/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，好好享受在七B的第一週。

script.youtube_title: 【剛搬進社區🏢】「你真是救星」一次問清泳池・賓客・圍欄規則🏊🎫🔧｜聽完就能自己問管理處｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜HOA Pool And Guest Rules
script.youtube_title_en: "You're a Lifesaver" — Asking the HOA Office About Pool and Guest Rules
script.youtube_description:
「你真是救星」——剛搬進社區，管理處的泳池、賓客、圍欄、管理費規則一次問清楚！這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區管理辦公室裡。

你會聽到：新住戶怎麼開口、要泳池手環與賓客證的完整說法；賓客證每月只有三張時怎麼追問；安靜時段、圍欄許可、顏色限制的實用句；還有自動扣款與更新登記地址的真實對話。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人日常禮貌語感：um、well、so、ha、fair。聽完你就會用：Can I...、What about...、That's fine、Anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"You're a lifesaver" — just moved in and the HOA office has a hundred rules? This 60-line immersive English listening practice walks you through one full chat about the pool, guests, and fees.

You will hear: how a new resident opens, asking for wristbands and guest passes; pushing back when the passes run short; quiet hours, the fence permit, and color rules; plus setting up autopay and fixing an old address.

Everything stays in A2 words with the polite hedging Americans use: um, well, so, ha, fair. By the end you'll own Can I..., What about..., That's fine, and Anytime.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛搬進社區，泳池要戴什麼？賓客證一個月幾張？想搭個小圍欄又要不要申請？這些問題見到管理處人員，你敢開口問嗎？

這一集帶大家走進社區管理辦公室，從借泳池手環、領賓客證、問安靜時段，一路聽到圍欄許可、管理費與自動扣款，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏊 開場句：Hi, I just moved in here, unit seven B.
🎫 領賓客證：Here, three per month, just sign this sheet.
🔧 問圍欄：Now, can I build a small fence?
💳 設自動扣款：Can I set up autopay right here today?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這個新住戶走一趟，下次自己走進管理處，話就自然冒出來。

祝你在新家一切順利。
